cases.name: valid
cases.note: unmodified base font (control)

cases.name: hdmx_numrecords_huge
cases.note: hdmx numRecords=0xFFFF with a two-byte record, so the table is far shorter than it claims

cases.name: hdmx_sizedevice_zero
cases.note: hdmx sizeDeviceRecord=0: recordCount*size == 0, so the stride is zero

cases.name: hdmx_count_times_size_overflow
cases.note: hdmx 0xFFFF*0xFFFF: the 16-bit multiply overflows if done in 16 bits

cases.name: maxp_numglyphs_huge
cases.note: maxp numGlyphs=0xFFFE while loca still describes the original count

cases.name: maxp_numglyphs_zero
cases.note: maxp numGlyphs=0 against a non-empty loca

cases.name: loca_short
cases.note: loca truncated to a quarter of its length, so glyph indices run off the end

cases.name: loca_empty
cases.note: loca replaced by four bytes of zeroes

cases.name: loca_offsets_past_glyf
cases.note: every loca entry points beyond the end of glyf

cases.name: glyf_glyph_span_huge
cases.note: loca entries that describe a single glyph spanning the whole font

cases.name: cmap_subtable_offset_oob
cases.note: cmap encoding record points 2 GB past the start of the table

cases.name: cmap_format4_segcount_huge
cases.note: format 4 subtable segCountX2=0xFFFF with no matching arrays

cases.name: head_unitsperem_zero
cases.note: head unitsPerEm=0, so every scaled metric collapses

cases.name: head_magic_bad
cases.note: head magicNumber replaced

cases.name: head_locformat_bad
cases.note: head indexToLocFormat=0x7FFF, neither short nor long

cases.name: name_count_huge
cases.note: name count=0xFFFF with a two-entry string table

cases.name: post_numglyphs_huge
cases.note: post numGlyphs=0xFFFF

cases.name: fpgm_inflated
cases.note: fpgm (font program) present with a length that implies deep instruction nesting

cases.name: prep_huge
cases.note: prep table of 64 KiB of malformed hinting bytecode

cases.name: dirent_numtables_huge
cases.note: sfnt numTables=0xFFFE with a directory that holds only the original count

cases.name: dirent_numtables_zero
cases.note: sfnt numTables=0: no tables at all

cases.name: dirent_offset_overflow
cases.note: first table offset 0xFFFFFF00 with length 0x200: the end wraps 32 bits

cases.name: dirent_length_huge
cases.note: first table claims a 2 GB length

cases.name: dirent_overlap
cases.note: second table shares the first table's offset, so two parsers read one blob

cases.name: trunc_8
cases.note: file truncated to 8 of 24500 bytes

cases.name: trunc_header
cases.note: file truncated to 490 of 24500 bytes

cases.name: trunc_half
cases.note: file truncated to 12250 of 24500 bytes

cases.name: trunc_tail
cases.note: file truncated to 23765 of 24500 bytes
